slides.title: Practical workflow: Module 1
slides.subtitle: A practical note for AI-Native Developer Workflow: Using AI Tools Without Losing Control

slides.title: The problem
slides.body: AI coding tools can move quickly, but a vague request often turns into a vague implementation.

slides.title: Control 1
slides.body: Start with a concrete spec, not a vague coding request.

slides.title: Control 2
slides.body: Put reusable context in repository files, not only in chat.

slides.title: Control 3
slides.body: Ask the agent to plan before it edits.
